narrative: The NSA's design-considerations document names the inverted client-server pattern, unverified task propagation and arbitrary-code-execution as core risks and ranks tool-poisoning highest because malicious server metadata enters the agent's context with instruction-level authority before review - exactly the in-host execution boundary the thesis says must move into an isolated launcher. VIPER-MCP's 67 CVEs confirm a per-field patch cannot be the defense.
remaining_gap: No reference MCP host or SDK has yet shipped a changed default that confines stdio tools to a separate process or container; the evidence is risk-naming, not an isolated launcher.
